intro: Along the jagged western edge of Westfall, shipwrecks litter the shoals while murloc tribes overrun the beaches. The ghostly Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse recruits capable adventurers to clear out these aquatic raiders so that shipwrecked mariners stand a chance of surviving their landfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast. The Great Sea is treacherous indeed. The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe. The Murlocs are trouble though.
Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Kill 7 Tidehunters, 7 Warriors, 7 Oracles and 7 Coastrunners and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. You have quite a knack for combat. Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
